content: विक्रान्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Stepped or passed beyond. .²2 Powerful, heroic, valiant, chivalrous; युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्तः <ls>Bg. 1. 6</ls>; <ls>Ki. 16. 2</ls>. .²3 Victorious, overpowering (oneʼs enemies). .{@-न्तः@} .²1 A hero, warrior. .²2 A lion. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a kind of संधि which leaves विसर्ग unchanged. .{@-न्तम्@} .²1 A pace, stride; तद्विक्रान्तैर्विजितानीह त्रीणि <ls>Mb. 13. 158. 20</ls>. .²2 Heroism, valour, prowess. .²3 The jewel called वैक्रान्त. .²4 A kind of intoxicating drink.
